note: WAEC Commerce round 3 (Round 21 top-up): home, foreign and entrepot trade, invisible trade, balance of trade vs payments, customs duties, embargo vs quota, bonded warehouses and free ports, WTO and UNCTAD, entrepreneurs and business plans, factor rewards, sole proprietorship, sleeping partners, partner limits, cooperative voting, public companies, equity vs loan capital, debentures as lending, trade credit, overdrafts, IPO and rights issues, insurance principles (indemnity, subrogation, contribution), policy documents, premiums, endowment assurance, marine cover, stock exchange jobbers, shares, amalgamation vs cartel, trade associations, SON and NAFDAC, business correspondence, e-commerce risks and tourism earnings. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-2, NECO Commerce and the JAMB pool.
